hooks.command: cmd=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))"); case "$cmd" in git\ commit*) : ;; *) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; exit 0 ;; esac; uv run pytest --tb=short -q --basetemp .pytest-tmp -p no:cacheprovider > .pytest-hook-last.log 2>&1; code=$?; if [ $code -eq 0 ] || [ $code -eq 5 ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; else echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"pytest exited $code - see .pytest-hook-last.log or rerun: uv run pytest\"}}"; fi
